summary: Fixed 4 review issues: 1) EgressPolicy.is_allowed now parses URL hostname with suffix matching to prevent subdomain bypass; 2) network_mode is configurable via SandboxConfig.network field; 3) port is extracted from container port bindings after creation (fallback to 8080); 4) EgressPolicy is wired into DockerSandbox as optional constructor parameter with log_allowlist() on startup
